field.label: Magic Editor X
field.description: Block editor with media, embeds, custom blocks, history and live collaboration
field.options.placeholder.label: Placeholder
field.options.placeholder.description: Text shown while the editor is empty
field.options.minHeight.label: Minimum height (px)
field.options.minHeight.description: Height of the empty editor, between 120 and 2000 pixels
field.options.preset.label: Preset
field.options.preset.description: Which blocks and formatting editors can use in this field. Enforced when saving.
field.options.linkTargets.label: Allowed links
field.options.linkTargets.description: Links to entries of this site, to web addresses, both or none
field.options.requireAlt.label: Require alternative text for images
field.options.requireAlt.description: Images need a text description or must be marked as decorative
field.options.allowedBlocks.label: Allowed blocks
field.options.allowedBlocks.description: Comma-separated block names that replace the preset list, for example: paragraph, header, list, image, myCustomBlock
field.options.headingLevels.label: Heading levels
field.options.headingLevels.description: For example 2-4 or 2,3. Empty uses the preset.
field.options.maxBlocks.label: Maximum number of blocks
field.options.maxCharacters.label: Maximum number of characters
field.options.maxCharacters.description: Visible text, counted like the editor toolbar. Empty or 0 means no limit.
field.options.disableAi.label: Turn off the AI assistant for this field
field.options.disableGrammar.label: Turn off the grammar check for this field
field.options.disableGrammar.description: No text from this field is sent to LanguageTool
field.options.disableCollaboration.label: Turn off live collaboration for this field
field.options.publishGuard.label: Block publishing while quality checks report errors
field.options.publishGuard.description: Errors are missing alternative texts (when required) and empty links
field.options.preset.article: Article: long-form text without raw HTML
field.options.preset.minimal: Minimal: paragraphs, lists, bold, italic, links
